correctness.rationale: Every possible bitangent explicitly enumerated (12 hyperflex + 16 ordinary) and verified by contact restriction; the total 28 follows from odd theta characteristics for a smooth genus-three curve in characteristic p>=5. Exhaustive Fp2 pair-intersection checks in characteristics 5,7,17 establish the exact multiplicity rows, including absence of >=5-fold points, and p=7 represents every other p>=5. value.rationale: Determining good-characteristic reductions of a canonical high-symmetry bitangent arrangement is geometrically motivated. Two primes, 5 and 17, cause distinct incidence-lattice jumps despite smoothness and all 28 bitangents persisting. Their exact triple-point counts and the cyclotomic norm obstruction give a structural classification and useful arithmetic boundary instead of an arbitrary table.
